cohort: Obese women (BMI ≥ 30kg/m2) with singleton gestations at ≥39 weeks without medical comorbidities.
finding: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks was associated with lower rates of cesarean delivery in both nulliparous and parous obese women compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks in obese women was associated with lower cesarean delivery rates compared to expectant management.
